terms.definition: Governed operating unit identified by epi_branchcode and resolved through the Acacia Enterprise Branch Map.
Enterprise care-delivery classification identified by epi_slid, including Home Health, Hospice, and Private Duty.
Distinct patients admitted on or before the as-of date who have not been discharged before that date.
Average active patient count per day across the governed reporting window.
Sum of daily active-patient observations across the reporting window.
Distinct patient episodes with a start-of-care date inside the reporting period.
A discharge classified as patient-initiated or hospice-initiated rather than death.
A referral or intake outcome that does not become an admitted patient episode.
Elapsed days from start of care through discharge, or through the as-of date for active patients.
Governed revenue divided by patient days for the same scope and reporting period.
Home-health payment adjustment associated with an episode below the applicable visit threshold.
